scope: E1 detection-only plus E1/E3 interaction; P2 partial
sample_class: previously used signal-adjacent development observations; not unseen or continuous validation

E2.factor: structural target and inverse entry only

E3.factor: replace fixed 30s wait with evidence readiness

E4.factor: nearby barrier exception and chase rules only

arms.capture_e1: capture plus PR21 first_retests proposals only; original target/rules/30s confirm
arms.structural_p1_e1: P1 plus PR21 first_retests proposals only; original rules/30s confirm

e3_definition.first_evaluation: including discovery if all evidence already present; no synthetic tick
e3_definition.trigger: frozen original breakout level; other strategies freeze last completed directional high/low at discovery
e3_definition.condition: real observed quote strictly crosses frozen trigger; current structure intact; all post-watch closed bars including first retain original stop; retain every existing cost/RR/context/RSI/structure/quote/chase/TTL/cooldown check
e3_definition.age_argument: actual observation minus watch timestamp; never spoof 30s
e3_definition.bar_availability: original nominal+0/15s scenarios; actual receipts remain null
e3_definition.same_observation_confirmation: permitted only after full second-stage checks; no claim of separate independent market evidence

frozen.target_policy: P1 byte-identical; no synthesized extension or threshold lowering
frozen.fees_and_risk: existing retained model, same in both arms per scenario

required_outputs: per-event first-candidate and confirmation lead, matching/excluded/added/unmatched
fixed model outcomes, horizons, same-event 30/60s manual delay
baseline full economic window outputs equal saved results
inference: diagnostic ablation only; do not select or promote a winner from these reused outcomes; P1 no-entry floor may make E3 unidentifiable

e1_definition.detector: Reuse lbank_entry_location.first_retests unchanged, merge only missing (strategy,direction) proposals ahead of capture fallback. Native bars and current real quote; no fake completed bar.
e1_definition.isolation: Do not enable location mode; keep capture candidate/confirmation/target barrier exceptions and chase checks. E4 and location confirmation progress remain excluded.
e1_definition.thresholds: PR21 first_retests byte-identical: 10-bar break, 0.5 ATR impulse/retest lower bound, 0.25 ATR upper bound, <=3 subsequent bars, 1.5 ATR resumption limit; no tuning.
e1_definition.event_matching: existing source-anchored canonical structure identity; no proximity/time matching
e1_definition.target_freeze: target algorithms, RR, costs, risk frozen per panel; discovery-dependent actual plans preserved; shared earliest observed S/T fixed separately for timing attribution
